sources.snippet: YFC-112358/Qwen3.8-27B-TA-Aux-v1 is a 27 billion parameter auxiliary model derived from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, created by YFC-112358. This model is constructed using a task arithmetic merge of six weaker fine-tuned parent models, designed specifically as a 'seasoning' component for stronger checkpoints rather than for standalone use. It leverages explicit coefficients in its merging recipe ...
